en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a hillside town with dense old European houses in the foreground and a large castle complex on the hill above. At the center-left a massive scaffolding structure surrounds a building under reconstruction, and a Gothic church tower rises just beside it. Printed red text in German at the top reads 'Meissen. Schlossberg mit dem Dom während des Umbaus.' indicating the castle hill and cathedral during renovation. Along the right edge there is a vertical imprint with the publisher and date.
